scenes.text: Can't read the menu in Korea? Just point and say this.
It means: this one, please. Point at what you want.
Use it at restaurants, cafes, and market stalls.
scenes.label: Say it

caption:
Can't read the menu in Korea? Point and say this 👉
이거 주세요 (i-geo ju-se-yo) = this one, please. Works at restaurants, cafes and market stalls.
